data.description: An interior ferry ticket office operating at night. The space features a shuttered ticket window facing empty benches. A counter is present where transactions occur. The office contains brass locker keys and numbered paper envelopes for storage. Frosted glass windows allow silhouettes to be visible from outside. A shutter mechanism with a crank is operated from inside.
data.name: Ferry Ticket Office
data.narrative_significance: A liminal space where clandestine exchanges occur under the guise of routine ferry operations. The cancelled last sailing creates isolation and opportunity for covert activity. The location serves as a transfer point for both legitimate medical supplies and mysterious numbered envelopes, suggesting dual purposes and hidden agendas among the characters.
scene_presence: Lena (ticket clerk with bandaged left thumb)
Courier in orange rain cape (silhouette only, appears outside)
